Idempotency-Replayed.description: Present, with the value `true`, only when the answer is a replay of the stored answer of an earlier request with the same Idempotency-Key.

unitNumberScheme.description: ISO6346 when the unit number was validated as an ISO 6346 container number; null for a free-form number (and for a trailer stored before ADR 0012).

securedAt.description: When the DOCKED trailer was secured (ADR 0013); null while it is not secured, and for every trailer stored before the interlock.

securedBy.description: How the trailer is secured, a vehicle restraint engaged or the wheels chocked (OSHA 29 CFR 1910.178(k)(1), ANSI MH30.3); null while it is not secured.

securerRef.description: The optional reference of the person who secured the trailer.

state.description: INTACT: present and unbroken, not yet verified (what existing flows produce). APPLIED: recorded as applied at the origin or dock. VERIFIED: checked at the gate against the expected number and equal. MISMATCH: checked and different (SealExceptionRaised was raised). BROKEN: found broken. NONE: no seal.

class.description: The ISO 17712 class of the seal; null when none was declared.

400.description: Malformed JSON body, an unknown field, a NUL byte, a missing or invalid Idempotency-Key, or an invalid path or query parameter.
